financial_health.claim: B2Gold held $ 380,424 in cash and cash equivalents and total current assets of 1,129,674 against total current liabilities of 1,061,256 at December 31, 2025, leaving a thin positive working-capital margin.

Total liabilities of 2,237,800 were funded by total equity of 3,641,516, giving total assets of 5,879,316 at December 31, 2025; long-term debt was 564,440 and the non-current gold stream obligation was 258,231.
Cash provided by operating activities was 895,836 for the year ended December 31, 2025, well above net income of $ 426,699, indicating strong cash conversion.

Non-cash charges of 805,682 were added back to arrive at operating cash flow, while delivery into prepaid gold sales consumed (288,792) of cash, meaning a meaningful share of operating cash was absorbed by prepayment deliveries rather than retained as liquid cash.
The current portion of long-term debt due within one year was 33,870, and the current portion of derivative instruments was 237,308, both well covered by year-end cash of $ 380,424.
Gold revenue rose to $ 3,061,238 from $ 1,902,030 and operating income swung to 1,382,259 from a loss of (248,327) in the prior year, underpinning the earnings recovery.

Cash used by investing activities was (892,740) in 2025, dominated by mine-development capex at Goose (471,453), Fekola (222,670), Masbate (41,257) and Otjikoto (24,005), nearly offsetting the year's operating cash inflow.

The company drew 445,913 on convertible senior secured notes and 195,869 on its revolving credit facility during 2025 while repaying 450,000 on the revolver, indicating active use of bank and debt markets to fund operations and capex.
